update.title: Added actionable guidance to Work Report creation and curation
update.summary: Added warnings about uncommitted changes and explicit evidence-review instructions, giving automated report creation clear next actions at each stage.

blocks.body:
## Put guidance where the work happens

Work Report separates recording what happened from choosing the evidence that supports it. I added guidance to the responses from both stages so an agent receives the next useful action with the result it just created.

Creation reports uncommitted changes as a nonblocking warning and points to evidence curation. Curation returns the full set of follow-up questions and instructions for reviewing the attached artifacts.

blocks.code:
ARTIFACT_REVIEW_INSTRUCTIONS = [
    "Review every attached artifact one-by-one before finalizing the report.",
    "Remove irrelevant artifacts (duplicates, noise, unrelated captures).",
    "For each kept artifact, ensure it clearly supports what changed.",
]
blocks.description: The curation response tells the agent to inspect each artifact, remove irrelevant material, and keep evidence that supports the reported change.

blocks.body:
## Make evidence review actionable

The follow-up guidance explains how to inspect, detach, edit, or recapture evidence and repeat curation when material is missing. Shared instructions replace stale references to the retired report wizard.

I added regression checks for creation warnings and curation responses. The resulting workflow preserves direct report creation while making the evidence-review step explicit.
